LanguageData.RPC_Reason_MustMatch: All {0} cyberware must match ({1} is installed).
LanguageData.RPC_NoDashLanding: No room to land next to the target.
LanguageData.RPC_ToggleBladesDesc: Extend or retract the mantis blades. Extended blades are used for every melee attack, even when holding a gun.
LanguageData.RPC_StaminaTip: Drains when attacking, refills while standing still.
LanguageData.RPC_StaminaExhaustedTip: Exhausted: can't attack and moves at half speed until stamina is full again.
LanguageData.RPC_StrikeTeamWarning: {0} won't let that slide. Expect a strike team.
LanguageData.RPC_RogueLetterText: {0}, a rogue cyberpsycho chromed to the teeth, has wandered into the area. They will attack anyone they see, and knocking them down won't stop them.
LanguageData.RPC_BuyTraumaTeamDesc: Pay {0} silver for {1} days of Trauma Team coverage. If this colonist goes down, a Trauma Team shuttle lands a squad that fights off whoever is hostile to them, extracts them and returns them patched up about a day later. One dispatch per coverage. Silver is taken from anywhere on the map.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamNoSilver: Not enough silver on the map ({0} needed).
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamBought: {0} is covered by Trauma Team for {1} days.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamLetterText: {0} is down. Their Trauma Team coverage has kicked in: a shuttle is inbound with a squad to secure and extract them.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamExtracted: Trauma Team has extracted {0}. They'll be back in about a day.
LanguageData.RPC_CycleShellDesc: Switch the projectile launch system to the next shell type.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamFailed: Trauma Team couldn't get {0} onto the shuttle. Extraction failed.
LanguageData.RPC_MaxTacLetterText: {0} is a cyberpsycho and has {1}. NCPD MaxTac is landing to put them down.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamReturnLetterText: Trauma Team has returned {0}, patched up.
LanguageData.RPC_Settings_FactionsDefault: Corps and gangs are the default factions (needs restart)
LanguageData.RPC_Settings_FactionsDefaultTip: New worlds start with the cyberpunk corporations and gangs selected. Vanilla and DLC factions stay available in the faction list but start unselected.
LanguageData.RPC_Settings_DiagnosticsTip: Writes RimPunkCE/Diagnostics/diag.log: RimPunk events, errors from RimPunk code, and hourly state checks. Turn off once testing is done.
